newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank of Portugal seen leaving repo rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Portugal seen leaving repo rate unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal will probably keep its repo rate unchanged at 7.10 percent when it reviews rates around 1415 GMT today ahead of the next commercial bank reserve period on Monday, according to six of eight dealers contacted by Reuters.
The other two expected a cut of up to 10 basis points.

Dealers said they saw room for further rate cuts later this year. Three of the eight dealers said the Bank of Portugal could trim the draining rate used to absorb funds from the money market on Monday. The draining rate is presently 6.80 percent.
